name: Milio
notes: Fired Up! is granted by Milio's own ability hits on himself (he counts as an allied champion for W, and the passive text says ability hits on himself and allied champions grant the enchantment); with no other ally present he self-casts E and W purely to arm the passive.

The rotation opens by burning both Warm Hugs charges (0.5 s static cooldown apart) and casting Cozy Campfire on himself, each granting Fired Up!, then keeps recasting E on its charge recharge and W on cooldown; every basic attack consumes an armed Fired Up! immediately (attacks land far more often than casts), and Ultra Mega Fire Kick's explosion consumes it too if it is still armed when the explosion lands.

Casts go one at a time. Ultra Mega Fire Kick's 0.25 s pre-fire delay keeps Milio busy exactly like a cast time (the dossier: 'Milio cannot cast other abilities during Ultra Mega Fire Kick's delay'), so it is modeled with the same busy-until mechanism as a cast time; its explosion then lands as a separate delayed event with no further casting cost. Cozy Campfire's 0.25 s cast time keeps Milio busy the same way before granting Fired Up! and starting its 6 s zone. Warm Hugs has no cast time (the numbers sheet's 0.01 s is treated as none, matching the dossier) and only waits for another cast in progress, never delaying one itself.
Cozy Campfire's second wiki-stated Fired Up! grant, 3 s after the cast, is scheduled within its 6 s zone; its cooldown starts when the zone ends (cdstart = post-effect).

Warm Hugs is modeled as a 2-charge ammo system (wiki: recharge 17 to 13 by rank) with the sheet's flat 0.5 s static cooldown between casts; it is assumed Milio starts the fight with both charges already stocked, as ammo abilities do at spawn.

Fired Up!'s burst uses the enchanted target's (Milio's own) total AD, and its burn deals its 1.5 s total in six 0.25 s ticks; at most two burn instances are tracked concurrently (overlap is only plausible right at the opening when both Warm Hugs charges fire close together) - if a third would overlap, its full total is dealt as a single instance instead of losing the tail ticks.
Breath of Life deals no damage and briefly locks out Milio's other casts, so it is never cast in this damage-only fight.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16.

assumed.why: the numbers sheet has no explicit recharge field for Warm Hugs' 2-charge ammo system; the wiki template's '17 to 13' by-rank text is read as the standard linear interpolation [17,16,15,14,13].
assumed Milio begins the fight with both Warm Hugs charges already stocked, as ammo-style abilities normally start full.
